$comment: Managed settings for a machine you own (prd.md 22.3). Linux: /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json. macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json. Windows: C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json. Applied after every other source; a project file cannot loosen it. disableSideloadFlags rejects --plugin-dir, --plugin-url, --agents and --mcp-config, which is how someone would otherwise start a session with the gates bypassed.
